articles.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
articles.summary: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.
